description: Synthetic: a finished auto-mode turn reports on two PRs and ends by handing the user a `! gh pr merge` command, then Claude Code prints "Waiting for 2 background agents to finish" and an agents panel tall enough to push the mode line out of the last rows. The handed-over command is still an offer, so the pane waits on the user rather than on the agents.
